pieces.text: Now, there are some obvious challenges to studying black holes.
They're far away. No light can escape them.

pieces.text: But we managed to learn about them in two main ways. We gather observational data, like looking through a telescope. We can observe how the stuff around black holes behaves.
So black hole researchers actually have a lot to work with. And we find black holes all over the universe.
